description: The JobCrawls owners page: who owns Finland's employers, ranked by the jobs the owner's companies advertised in the last 12 months. Each owner has its country, kind, open ads, the number of employing companies, the largest companies it controls and, per company, the ownership chain with the register or site that names each step and its date. Filters: kind of owner (Finnish, listed, foreign, private equity, public), a name text and an option to leave out staffing groups. Owners who are private persons are not in the data. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

excludeStaffing.description: Leave out owners whose companies mostly post for staffing clients. Default false: they are listed, as on the page.

locale.description: Language of the result and of the linked jobcrawls.com pages. Defaults to English.

name.description: Only owners whose name, or a controlled company's name, contains this text.

name: get_employer_owners

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.

title: Who owns Finland's employers
